find_units_by_task_id: find all units in the database filtered by a specific task_id
find_units_by_status: find all units in the database filtered by one or more status values
find_units_by_task_and_status: find all units matching both a task_id and a list of statuses
find_all_units: find all units in the database with no filters applied
review_find_units: review the find_units function that queries the units table with optional task_id and status filters
